name: EZ-Bar Floor Skull Crusher
summary: A triceps extension performed lying supine on the floor, using the ground to pause between repetitions and reduce shoulder and elbow strain.

setup: Lie flat on your back on the floor or an exercise mat, with knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold an EZ-bar above your upper chest or forehead with an overhand grip on the inner bends, arms extended.
steps: Lower the bar under control by bending at the elbows until the weight plates gently touch the floor overhead behind your head.
Allow the weight to come to a brief, dead-stop pause on the floor without letting tension leave the triceps completely.
Drive the weight back up by extending your elbows until your arms return to the starting position.
instructions.breathing: Inhale as you lower the bar to the floor, and exhale as you press back up to full extension.
cues: Dead stop on the floor, no bouncing

common_faults.fault: Bouncing the plates off the floor to gain momentum.
common_faults.correction: Pause completely on the floor to eliminate the stretch reflex before extending.

common_faults.fault: Flaring the elbows outward excessively during the press.
common_faults.correction: Keep the elbows tucked shoulder-width apart and pointing toward the ceiling throughout the repetition.

precautions: Ensure standard-sized plates or bumpers are used if needed so the bar settles at an appropriate height overhead without risking facial contact.
